ingameEffects.label: Knight's Rite (W-Engine Passive)
ingameEffects.description: When the equipper's Basic Attack or EX Special Attack's heavy attack hits an enemy, they gain 1 stack of Battle Edge, increasing CRIT DMG for 25s. Battle Edge can stack up to 2 times, and each skill type can provide up to 1 stack. Repeated triggers refresh the duration of all Battle Edge. At 2 stacks of Battle Edge, the equipper gains Bonechill: Their DMG ignores a percentage of the target's Ice RES.
ingameEffects.shortDescription: The equipper's CRIT DMG is increased for 25s, stacking up to 2 times.
